name: claude-mod-themes
description: Terminal stats panes, a spend guard, themes and a stats band for Claude Code.

plugins.name: tool-histogram
plugins.description: /nerd stats pane with a text pie, activity heatmap and charts; /nerd history, /nerd export and /budget (spend limit, context and slow-tool warnings).

plugins.name: nerd-theme
plugins.description: /skin switches between nine color themes (or random) shared by every nerd mod; adds duration and +/- cards under tool rows.

plugins.name: nerd-band
plugins.description: A stats row above the prompt: uptime, turns, tool calls, cost, context, a per-turn trend and your top tool.

plugins.name: failure-log
plugins.description: /fails opens a pane collecting failed or denied tool calls so errors do not scroll away.

plugins.name: file-tracker
plugins.description: /files opens a pane listing every file Claude edited or wrote this session, with edit counts.
